#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <stdexcept>

int main() {
    std::string line;
    if (!std::getline(std::cin, line)) {
        return 1;
    }
    
    int count = 0;
    int start = 0;
    int n = line.length();
    
    while (start < n) {
        int end = start;
        char current = line[start];
        while (end < n && line[end] == current) {
            end++;
        }
        int len = end - start;
        count += (len + 1) % 2;
        start = end;
    }
    
    std::cout << count << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
